svg.aria-label: Calibrated errors of the COST-G July 2026 field, per coefficient
svg.title: Calibrated errors of the COST-G July 2026 field, per coefficient
svg.text: Calibrated errors of the COST-G July 2026 field, per coefficient
Equivalent water height of each coefficient's error, mm (log scale). Sine coefficients left of the zonal column, cosine right.
Real data in the layout of Zingerle et al. (2024), Fig. 3a/c, which shows simulated NGGM and CAI11 errors.
Unsmoothed: errors grow with degree and toward high orders, the pattern that becomes north–south stripes on maps. Data: COST-G (CC BY 4.0).
